problems.description: Attackers send deceptive emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all user accounts
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user awareness training and simulated phishing exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing campaigns aimed at specific individuals or roles within an organization to gain access to sensitive information or systems.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify and block targeted phishing attempts
Train employees on recognizing social engineering tactics
Limit access privileges based on role and need-to-know basis

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof business email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive data from employees.
risk_reduction: Verify financial requests through secondary communication channels
Enable email authentication protocols like SPF, DKIM, and DMARC
Monitor email account activity for unusual behavior

problems.description: Attackers intercept communications over unsecured or poorly secured Wi-Fi networks to capture sensitive data such as passwords and session tokens.
risk_reduction: Use WPA3 encryption on wireless networks
Encourage use of VPNs when accessing public Wi-Fi
Disable automatic Wi-Fi connections to untrusted networks

problems.description: Attackers downgrade HTTPS connections to HTTP, intercepting and modifying data transmitted between users and websites without detection.
risk_reduction: Enforce HTTPS using HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security)
Use up-to-date TLS protocols and certificates
Educate users to verify secure connection indicators in browsers

problems.description: Attackers manipulate DNS responses to redirect users to malicious sites, enabling interception or alteration of communications.
risk_reduction: Implement DNSSEC to validate DNS responses
Use trusted DNS resolvers with security features
Monitor DNS traffic for anomalies and unauthorized changes
